scene: The robot's exposed hatch displays blinking transit tokens for three city exits.
picture: Flat side view of an expansive transit balcony. The player in a red bomber jacket stands on white roller skates before three departure platforms. On the left, a solar-sail junk rocks gently by an open dock. In the centre sits a gleaming dragon-headed maglev train with open doors. On the right, a round cloud cable pod hangs ready.
